principle: Every label names a structure prototype, never a chemical class (Oxide, Telluride) and never a specific compound (Bi2Te3, PbTe). Bi2Te3 and Sb2Te3 are both tetradymite; PbTe, SnTe and AgSbTe2 are all rocksalt; BiCuSeO and LaFeAsO are both ZrCuSiAs-type.
relation_to_hand_labels: None. The hand-entered MaterialFamily values in sample_info were NOT used to build this taxonomy and are not shown to the annotator. They are held back in df_host_systems.parquet as an independent set for validating this classification later.
grounding: Prototypes were selected by surveying the 700 highest-count host systems in data/annotated/input/df_host_systems.parquet, which cover ~85% of the TE sample set. example_host_systems on each entry are real keys from that table.
mp_id_policy: null until resolved against the Materials Project API in stage 2. Never fill these in from memory.

fields.id: stable snake_case key, used in annotations and by_family/ filenames
fields.exemplar: a compound in this dataset that is a clean instance
fields.space_group: space group of the aristotype; distortions noted in notes
fields.stoichiometry: formula signature -- the fastest discriminator when annotating
fields.structural_class: navigation grouping only, never the label itself
fields.example_host_systems: real host_system keys from the input table that should land here
fields.discriminate_from: confusable prototype ids, each with the test that separates them
fields.mp_id: filled in stage 2 by querying Materials Project
fields.confidence_note: present when the prototype assignment for a listed host system needs checking in stage 2

discriminate_from.spinel: Fe3O4 is spinel while Fe2O3 is corundum -- the Fe-O host holds both

prototypes.notes: alpha-Al2O3, hematite Fe2O3, Cr2O3, Ti2O3.

discriminate_from.corundum: AB2O4 with both tetrahedral and octahedral cations

prototypes.notes: Normal and inverse ferrite spinels, LiMn2O4, LiV2O4 heavy-fermion spinel. Record normal vs inverse when stated.

discriminate_from.rocksalt: same prototype; separated so the monoxides shard together

prototypes.notes: NiO, CdO, CoO, MnO. Li-for-Ni is the classic acceptor doping.

discriminate_from.cuprite: Cu2O is cubic Pn-3m -- check the oxidation state; the Cu-O host holds both

prototypes.notes: CuO and Cu2O both occur in the Cu-O host.
p-type transparent oxide.
YAG.

discriminate_from.garnet: cage framework with extra-framework anions that can be replaced by electrons

prototypes.notes: C12A7 electride -- the free-electron concentration is the doping variable.

discriminate_from.perovskite: ordered Cu on three quarters of the A sites, with heavily tilted octahedra

prototypes.notes: Colossal dielectric constant.

discriminate_from.metallic_glass: oxide or chalcogenide glass rather than metallic

prototypes.notes: No periodic structure -- stage 2 skips these. Chalcogenide glasses and oxide glasses.

discriminate_from.high_entropy_alloy: distinct phases coexisting, not one disordered lattice

prototypes.notes: Composition strings of the form (X)a(Y)b with large a,b signal a composite. Record the matrix prototype and the inclusion prototype separately rather than forcing one label.

discriminate_from.graphite_layered: molecular or polymeric rather than an extended carbon net

prototypes.notes: PEDOT:PSS, polyaniline. Mostly out of scope for this inorganic TE set -- the organic project has its own table.
Graphite, graphene, CNT, reduced graphene oxide and intercalation compounds. Morphology is a separate attribute, not a different prototype.
